Seven merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a `hasPrivilege` line in `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. They are listed newest first, with the merge date taken from each squash commit's date. Two other matching commits touched only test files under `api/src/test`, so I left them out.

1. **#6674** (TRUNK-6823), merged 2026-10-13. Javadoc lines in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory.java:46-48} changed.
2. **#6668** (TRUNK-6802), merged 2026-10-13. Calls to `Context.hasPrivilege` were replaced in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory.java:158}, @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java:72}, and @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/PrivilegeResolution.java:30}. Javadoc in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/LegacyContextAuthentication.java:32} and @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator.java:176} also changed.
3. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08. Javadoc references changed in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/cache/RolePrivileges.java:26} and @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/OpenmrsAuthenticationToken.java:41-116}. This was the largest match set, with 46 matching lines in total.
4. **#6598** (TRUNK-6707), merged 2026-10-01. A new `Context.hasPrivilege(gp.getViewPrivilege(), false)` check was added at @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/AdministrationServiceImpl.java:194}.
5. **#6383** (TRUNK-6712), merged 2026-07-24. A new overload `Context.hasPrivilege(String, boolean)` was added at @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java:757-763}, and @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/UserContext.java:405} was changed.
6. **#6233** (ported TRUNK-6429 and TRUNK-6515), merged 2026-07-01. Calls in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/scheduler/jobrunr/JobRunrSchedulerService.java:340-395} were changed, including removal of `user.hasPrivilege(...)` at line 360.
7. **#6186**, merged 2026-06-18. `Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS)` was added at @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/notification/impl/AlertServiceImpl.java:119}.

Excluded: **#6508** (TRUNK-6698 and TRUNK-6776, 2026-09-03) matched only in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/aop/AuthorizationAdviceHierarchyTest.java}. The commit `3310bc1` (TRUNK-6705 follow-up, 2026-08-26) has no PR number in its subject and matched only in @file:{openmrs-core::api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/context/UserContextTest.java:177}.

Notes:
- The repository is indexed as `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core`. The bare name `openmrs-core` returned "not found", so I used the full name for the search.
- The search covers the default branch at HEAD, which I took as the pinned head since no other head was given. I did not separately confirm each commit is a merge into main.
- The dates are commit dates from the search results. I did not check them against separate merge timestamps.
